p6_b5.ocr: Q3FY24 saw a P/E Ratio of 15.0, with a Current Ratio of 2.1, Debt/Equity of 0.8, ROE of 18%, Gross Margin 34%, Net Margin 13%, Quick Ratio 1.3, Operating Margin 23%, Return on Assets 8%, Liquidity Ratio 4.5, and Efficiency Ratio 78%. In Q4FY24, the metrics reached a P/E Ratio of 16.0, Current Ratio of 2.2, Debt/Equity of 0.9, ROE of 19%, Gross Margin 35%, Net Margin 14%, Quick Ratio 1.4, Operating Margin 24%, Return on Assets 9%, Liquidity Ratio 5.0, and Efficiency Ratio 76%. The total customer acquisition metrics in Q1 included 15,000 New Customers, with a Customer Retention Rate of 85%, Marketing Spend of £500K, and Customer Lifetime Value of £1.5M; Q2 showed 20,000 New Customers at an 83% retention rate with a £600K marketing spend.

p6_b6.ocr: In Q3, there were 22,000 New Customers with a £750K marketing spend and a 75% retention rate, while Q4 reported 25,000 New Customers with a £1.0M marketing spend and a retention rate of 78%. The Annual Summary indicated a Total New Customers figure of 70,000, an Average Retention Rate of 80%, Total Marketing Spend of £4.6M, and Total Customer Value of £10.0M, with a Customer Feedback Score of 4.5/5, a Net Promoter Score of 60, Customer Satisfaction Rate of 90%, and a Customer Churn Rate of 15%. Strategic Insights revealed a Conversion Rate of 12%, Cost Per Acquisition of £30, and highlighted Retention Strategies including Social Media, Loyalty Programs, and Email Campaigns at 18%. Additional channels included Referral Programs, Webinars, and Incentives with respective values of £25, £20, and £15.
